# SellerStack AI
> Independent directory of AI tools for Amazon FBA, Shopify and e-commerce sellers with honest verdicts.

## Product Research
- [Jungle Scout](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/jungle-scout/): Amazon market intelligence and product validation. Limitation: Estimates are modeled, not actual sales
- [Helium 10](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/helium-10/): All-in-one Amazon suite (research, keywords, listings, PPC). Limitation: Broad but deep tiers get pricey; learning curve
- [SmartScout](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/smartscout/): Brand/seller-level market mapping and wholesale sourcing. Limitation: Less useful for private-label keyword work
- [Viral Launch](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/viral-launch/): Product discovery plus keyword research. Limitation: Overlaps heavily with Jungle Scout/Helium 10
- [SellerSprite](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/sellersprite/): Low-cost keyword and product research across marketplaces. Limitation: UI/translation rough in places
- [Keepa](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/keepa/): Price/BSR history tracking. Limitation: Not AI-driven; data-heavy charts
- [SellerApp](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/sellerapp/): Research plus PPC automation in one. Limitation: Jack of all trades

## Listing Optimization
- [ZonGuru](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/zonguru/): AI listing engineering (Helix) for Amazon. Limitation: Now listing-focused and priced per catalog size; costly for one-product sellers
- [Datadive](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/datadive/): Keyword ranking juice and listing optimization from competitor data. Limitation: Analytical; not for casual users
- [Helium 10 Listing Builder](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/helium-10-listing-builder/): AI listing copy with keyword coverage scoring. Limitation: Requires Helium 10 subscription
- [Jasper](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/jasper/): Brand-voice copy for product pages and ads. Limitation: Not Amazon-specific; needs keyword input from another tool
- [Copy.ai](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/copy-ai/): Go-to-market AI workflows for sales and marketing teams. Limitation: Repositioned as GTM platform; not marketplace-aware, overkill for listings

## PPC & Ads
- [Perpetua](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/perpetua/): Goal-based Amazon/Walmart ad automation. Limitation: Less granular manual control
- [Teikametrics](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/teikametrics/): AI bid optimization tied to inventory/profit. Limitation: Pricing scales with ad spend
- [Ad Badger](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/ad-badger/): Rules-based Amazon PPC bid automation. Limitation: Older UI; less AI than rivals
- [Quartile](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/quartile/): Managed + AI ad optimization across retail channels. Limitation: Enterprise-oriented
- [Pacvue](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/pacvue/): Enterprise retail media management. Limitation: Overkill and costly for small sellers
- [Scale Insights](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/scale-insights/): Template-based Amazon PPC automation. Limitation: Setup takes effort

## Inventory & Forecasting
- [Inventory Planner](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/inventory-planner/): Demand forecasting and POs for Shopify/multi-channel. Limitation: Now part of Sage; pricing by revenue
- [Prediko](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/prediko/): AI demand forecasting for Shopify. Limitation: Shopify-only focus
- [SoStocked](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/sostocked/): Amazon inventory forecasting and reorder planning. Limitation: Amazon-centric; pricing not published on site

## Customer Service
- [Gorgias](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/gorgias/): E-com helpdesk with AI agent and Shopify integration. Limitation: Ticket-based pricing adds up
- [Tidio](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/tidio/): Chat widget plus Lyro AI agent. Limitation: AI usage billed separately
- [Yuma AI](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/yuma-ai/): Autonomous AI support agent on top of helpdesks. Limitation: Needs an existing helpdesk
- [Zipchat](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/zipchat/): AI sales/support chat for Shopify. Limitation: Smaller vendor
- [eDesk](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/edesk/): Marketplace-native helpdesk (Amazon, eBay, Shopify). Limitation: Less suited to pure DTC

## Image & Creative
- [Pebblely](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/pebblely/): AI product lifestyle backgrounds. Limitation: Results vary; check Amazon image rules
- [Photoroom](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/photoroom/): Background removal and batch product photos. Limitation: Generated scenes still need review
- [Flair.ai](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/flair-ai/): AI product photoshoots with brand control. Limitation: Learning curve for best results
- [Claid.ai](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/claid-ai/): Image enhancement/standardization at catalog scale. Limitation: API-oriented
- [Canva](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/canva/): Infographics, A+ content, ads with Magic AI tools. Limitation: Generic templates look generic

## Multi-channel & Ops
- [Feedonomics](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/feedonomics/): Managed product feed optimization across channels. Limitation: Enterprise pricing
- [Linnworks](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/linnworks/): Multi-channel inventory/order management. Limitation: Implementation effort
- [ChannelEngine](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/channelengine/): Marketplace integration hub. Limitation: Enterprise-leaning

## Analytics & Profit
- [sellerboard](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/sellerboard/): Accurate Amazon profit tracking incl. fees/PPC/COGS. Limitation: Amazon-focused; UI basic
- [Triple Whale](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/triple-whale/): Shopify attribution and profit dashboards with AI. Limitation: Attribution is modeled; costly at scale
- [Klaviyo](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/klaviyo/): Email/SMS with AI segmentation and predictive analytics. Limitation: Price grows with list size
- [Getida](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/getida/): FBA reimbursement recovery. Limitation: Commission-based; similar services exist

## Reviews & Feedback
- [FeedbackWhiz](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/feedbackwhiz/): Amazon review requests, monitoring, profit. Limitation: Amazon limits what requests can say
- [Yotpo](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/yotpo/): Reviews, UGC and loyalty for Shopify. Limitation: Gets expensive
- [Judge.me](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/judge-me/): Affordable Shopify product reviews. Limitation: Less advanced AI than premium tools
- [Okendo](https://mshawn2000.github.io/sellerstack-ai/tools/okendo/): Reviews/UGC/surveys for Shopify Plus-type brands. Limitation: Premium pricing
